method.selection: Author-provided high quality flag Yes; no model prediction or target-score evaluation performed.
method.nominal_alignment: Concatenate UP,h35,spacs,h10,disc,ITR; define design-time ITR start as nominal TSS; extract preceding 50 bp. Actual TSS and indexing convention not established for each record.
method.comparison: Available nominal-window shifts +/-5, both orientations, global edit distance <=5 against all course sequences and previously evaluated external windows. Boundary shifts that lack 50 bp are skipped.
method.limitations: In-vitro RNAP/sigma70 transcription measurements differ from prior cellular assays; synthetic library has shared scaffold and repeated sequences. This screen does not prove independence or alignment validity.

interpretation: Source feasibility audit only. Data quality flags and presence of positive numeric labels were inspected; no model scoring or predictive metric was computed. Do not call a fully blind independent test.
